briefdescription.para: Create an empty collection of AliasSets, and use the specified alias analysis object to disambiguate load and store addresses.
These methods are used to add different types of instructions to the alias sets.

detaileddescription.para: Adding a new instruction can result in one of three actions happening:

listitem.para: If the instruction doesn't alias any other sets, create a new set.
If the instruction aliases exactly one set, add it to the set
If the instruction aliases multiple sets, merge the sets, and add the instruction to the result.

briefdescription.para: Return the alias sets that are active.
Return the alias set which contains the specified memory location.

detaileddescription.para: If the memory location aliases two or more existing alias sets, will have the effect of merging those alias sets before the single resulting alias set is returned.

briefdescription.para: Return the underlying alias analysis object used by this tracker.
mergeAliasSetsForMemoryLocation - Given a memory location, merge all alias sets that may alias it.

detaileddescription.para: Return the unified set, or nullptr if no aliasing set was found. A known existing alias set for the pointer value of the memory location can be passed in (or nullptr if not available). MustAliasAll is updated to true/false if the memory location is found to MustAlias all the sets it merged.

briefdescription.para: Merge all alias sets into a single set that is considered to alias any memory location or instruction.
